title: Grade against 3.14, not just run on it
objective: meta/pyproject.toml's ruff, mypy and pylint targets must name the same Python that requires-python and the CI pin already name (3.14), and the tree must be clean under those targets. Success is every lint, type and style gate passing at py314 with no suppressions added.
acceptance_criteria: meta/pyproject.toml has target-version = "py314", python_version = "3.14" and py-version = "3.14"
No noqa, type: ignore or per-file-ignores were added
out_of_scope: Dependency version pins (handled by the separate freshness gate and its own commit)
CI workflow files, which already pin python-version 3.x
app/ and web/ subtrees, which are not Python
verifier: pre-commit run --all-files (ruff, ruff-format, mypy, pylint), plus the repo's CI mirror on push
